text: Close one reality→priority feedback loop: ground idea value in real outcomes, not self-report
description: Replace the mock economy (credits in system.json) with at least one real signal flowing back into idea value/priority — e.g. test outcomes, PR merges, replies, or revenue automatically adjusting intrinsicValue/cost. Turns directed breeding into real selection pressure that doesn't route through the human.

status.comment:
The safe realized-output diagnostic is shipped. Further outcome-to-value automation requires a human-authorized external signal and a value-model decision; intrinsic value must not be mutated autonomously.

Status reconciliation on 2026-07-30 preserved the implemented non-corrupting reality signal and recognized that the stated remainder depends on the credential-gated effector layer plus human authority over value semantics.

Outcome: Found the mock economy (performWork credits) is dead and disconnected from priority — the premise was stale and there was no real→priority link at all. Asked Felix the design fork (his value model, his call); he chose the non-corrupting option. Shipped realizedCommits (git-reference count) + an openIdeasWithNoRealizedOutput diagnostic in get_prioritized_ideas, with intrinsicValue/cost untouched. Effectiveness: Right call to investigate + ask before coding: blind-building the literal task would have polished dead code, and auto-mutating intrinsicValue would have corrupted the human-curated model. The shipped slice is real, safe, and unit-tested. Lesson: When an idea says 'replace X', verify X is actually load-bearing first — here X was dead. And for anything touching the human value model, surface the design fork rather than guess; 'humans stay final authority' applies to the priority model itself. Pattern: verify-the-premise; ask-before-touching-the-value-model
